Summary: Kindness is love in action toward others, gentle, generous, and undeserved — a fruit of the Spirit and a mark of God's own character. Scripture commends small kindnesses as well as great ones: a cup of water, a word of encouragement, a welcome to the stranger. Kindness is not weakness; it is strength under control, choosing to bless even when retaliation would be easier.
KeyPassages: Ruth 2:8-13; Proverbs 11:17; Luke 6:35-36; Galatians 5:22; Ephesians 4:32; Titus 3:4-5
RelatedBooks: Ruth; Proverbs; Luke; Galatians; Ephesians; Titus
